stem: Fresh pest signs are found while a pruning team is moving through rooms. What should happen?
choices: Apply the required stop, isolation, sanitation, and movement controls before continuing through cleaner areas, and escalate the fresh pest finding.
Continue the planned pruning route because stopping mid-route creates more plant stress.
Move a suspect plant into a clean room for better inspection while the rest of the team continues.
Prune off the visible evidence so tools and workers can continue without a hold.
rationale: Fresh pest evidence changes the biosecurity risk of the work route. Continuing with the same tools or moving suspect material through clean areas can spread contamination. Technician I should apply the defined stop/isolation and sanitation controls, preserve the evidence, and escalate before normal movement resumes.
